error_load: Could not fetch updates. Is the integration loaded?
confirm_body_backup: Do you want to back up and update
confirm_skip_hint: You can restore it later from the skipped list.
history_no_recorder: Recorder is not available. Enable the recorder integration to track install history.
history_info_suffix: depth depends on your recorder settings
history_recorder_note: History depth depends on your recorder settings (purge_keep_days)
restart_banner: Home Assistant needs to be restarted for recent changes to take effect.
confirm_restart_body: Are you sure you want to restart Home Assistant? This will cause a brief outage.
not_installable_tooltip: This update cannot be installed right now
fl_info_hint: Supervisor always goes first — the platform itself requires it. Everything else runs lowest-risk first, saving the restart-heavy OS and Core updates for last, once HACS/add-ons/firmware are already confirmed healthy. Device firmware is excluded by default below — check it in manually if you want it included.
fl_btn_day: Make my day – Install all selected with a Full backup
fl_btn_crash: Make my crash — Install all selected, but No backup (Danger mode)
fl_blocked_tooltip: OPCON is Code Red — reset it first
fl_confirm_body: This will run, in this order:
fl_danger_ack: I understand no backup is taken before this run.
host_reboot_banner: The host needs to be rebooted for a recent OS update to take effect.
confirm_host_reboot_body: Are you sure you want to reboot the host? This will cause a brief outage while the whole system restarts.
ap_run_now_confirm: Run Autopilot now? A full backup is taken first, then all ready updates are installed. Home Assistant may restart.
ap_code_red: OPCON is Code Red. Autopilot will not run until it is reset.
ap_new_banner: new component(s) are installed but not in the schedule ("Only selected"). Tick them below if Autopilot should update them, then save.
ap_mode_off_hint: Nothing of this type is installed by Autopilot.
ap_mode_all_hint: Everything is included. Newly installed ones are included automatically.
ap_mode_all_except_hint: Tick the ones Autopilot should never touch. Newly installed ones are included automatically.
ap_mode_only_hint: Tick the ones Autopilot may update. Newly installed ones are NOT included until you tick them.
ap_core_hint: Core always runs last — it restarts Home Assistant by itself.
ap_unsupported: Autopilot only handles Core, apps (add-ons) and HACS. Supervisor, OS, device firmware and other updates are not supported and are never touched.
ap_no_days: No weekdays selected — Autopilot will never run.
ap_min_age_hint: Lets the rest of the world find the bugs in .0 releases first. Default 7.
ap_major_hint: Not recommended: major versions often contain breaking changes. Leave this off and install them by hand.
ap_ev_prewarn: Heads-up before the run (with "Skip tonight" on mobile)
ap_ev_summary: Summary when the run is done
ap_ev_restarted: Home Assistant is back after a restart
ap_ev_nothing: No updates to install (confirms Autopilot ran)
ap_ev_new: New components not in the schedule
ap_err_blocked_busy: Another update run was in progress
ap_restarted: Home Assistant was restarted to finish HACS updates.
ap_save_failed: Could not save the Autopilot settings.
backup_failed_alert: The backup failed, so nothing was updated.
ap_no_phones: No phones found. Install the Home Assistant Companion app on your phone and log in — it shows up here automatically.
ap_no_targets: No receivers — you will only see results in this panel.
ap_skip_needs_phone: The "Skip tonight" button only appears on phones (Companion app).
ap_adv_body: Every Autopilot step is fired as the event advanced_update_manager_autopilot — whatever you ticked above. Use it to announce on a speaker, flash a lamp, post to a chat… The field "event" tells what happened: prewarn, start, backup_ok, backup_failed, update_failed, summary, restarted, nothing_to_do, new_components, and when a run ends: success, failed, skipped, blocked.
